results.description: An ordinary account holder retrieves private invoices belonging to a different organization by guessing invoice numbers.
A guest can read confidential employee profiles without signing in.
Changing the owner identifier in an API request reveals another customer's billing history.
A basic user successfully invokes a supervisor-only approval operation.
A mobile client displays confidential records from unrelated customers after a resource identifier is modified.
An anonymous visitor downloads internal payroll documents through a predictable endpoint.
A student accesses another student's grades by modifying the record number.
A customer can cancel purchases made by someone else without permission.
An unprivileged session retrieves administrator audit logs.
An attacker swaps the account reference and receives another tenant's confidential documents.
A search field accepts a UNION SELECT payload that exposes database rows.
An attacker changes a filter parameter to alter the WHERE clause of a database query.
A login form concatenates user-controlled strings directly into an SQL statement.
A crafted input changes the application's database query logic.
A malicious product ID causes the database to execute unintended commands.
An attacker supplies an always-true condition to bypass a database-backed login.
An HTTP parameter is inserted into a query without parameter binding, allowing data extraction.
A reporting endpoint executes an injected ORDER BY expression.
Untrusted form data becomes executable SQL inside a search operation.
A manipulated request triggers unauthorized database updates through unsafe query construction.
A production management interface is reachable from the internet without authentication.
A deployed appliance still accepts its factory-default administrator password.
A diagnostic endpoint exposes environment variables to unauthenticated visitors.
The web server allows anonymous directory listing of sensitive files.
A production application exposes detailed stack traces and internal paths.
The firewall was disabled, leaving the administrative console accessible from any IP address.
A public cloud storage container permits unrestricted reading of confidential backups.
An administrator accidentally enables debug mode on the public production website.
A database dashboard is exposed to the internet with no network restrictions.
The server's security controls were disabled, exposing a sensitive diagnostic console.
A developer removes default credentials before deploying the application.
An employee downloads a report explicitly authorized for their account.
A security engineer disables debug mode on the production server.
An administrator blocks external access to the management interface.
A database developer uses prepared statements to safely process search input.
A tester reviews SQL syntax in an isolated training exercise.
An approved staging environment runs a diagnostic console for internal testing.
A security review documents a previously exposed endpoint that has now been fixed.
An authorized analyst accesses audit logs using an approved administrative account.
A system administrator patches a misconfigured service and verifies that access restrictions are restored.
